purpose: Pre-registered fault catalog for probe-coproduct (add-coproduct-exhaustiveness RED task 1, design Decision 5). Committed before any run; a correction is a superseding ledger entry, never an edit. Rationale: the G3 claim that rogue and dual-covered coproduct rows are silently accepted is judged against this file, not against prose written after the run.
